title: [BOB-027] Адресность ломается в форум-топике: псевдо-reply на корень топика
description: КОРНЕВОЙ баг (с BOB-023): в форум-топике Telegram каждое сообщение несёт неявный reply_to_message на КОРЕНЬ топика (reply_to_message.message_id == message_thread_id), созданный owner'ом. gateway._reply_to_sender_id слепо брал reply_to_message.from_user.id = owner (27468732) для ВСЕХ сообщений → classify_addressivity видела reply на не-Боба → DIRECTED_TO_OTHER → SILENT. Итог: Боб отвечал ТОЛЬКО на «Боб,…»/@mention; безметочные сообщения вообще не были ambient, floor (BOB-025) и адресность (BOB-023) были бессильны. Найдено живой диагностикой ADDR-DIAG (reply_to=27468732 на всех). ФИКС: игнорировать топиковый псевдо-reply (message_id корня == thread_id → None). Подтверждено вживую: безметочное → ambient → engage; floor поднимает непрерывность. Тесты: топик-корень→None, реальный reply в топике→sender сохраняется.
close_reason: Фикс форум-топик псевдо-reply отгружён; адресность+floor подтверждены вживую (ADDR-DIAG: безметочное→ambient→engage).

[PASS] Correctness of the human model. urge.py is a pure weighted sum over named drives (mood/longing/salience/circadian/energy), each term in [0,1], normalised by total weight -> monotone non-decreasing in every drive; _longing_drive saturates (1 - exp(-t/tau)) so a day of silence is felt without runaway; circadian is a per-local-hour baseline (night floor, morning + evening peaks, midday dip). Firing is genuinely stochastic, NOT a schedule: decision.py maps urge -> p via a monotone logistic, then draws once from an injected seeded RNG (rng.random() less-than p). Governance (governance.py) is a pure veto layer only: muted, quiet-hours hard floor on LOCAL time (wrap-around window handled), anti-spam per-window ceiling, min-gap, owner-cooldown. allows() returns 'not any(vetoes)' — ceilings, never a driver. Matches 'human, not cron'.

[PASS] Cheap guarantee. engine.tick() runs the pure decision first (_should_speak: store load + window count + urge + seeded draw) — ZERO LLM. Only a genuine fire pays for the Tier-0 gate; only a non-SKIP gate pays for compose. _parse_gate defaults to skip on anything but a 'SAY:' line. Default is silent.

[PASS] Determinism. Time + randomness fully injected: Clock.now() everywhere; the only random. in src is the injected seeded random.Random and a SystemRandom used solely to PICK a fallback seed (not the draw). No datetime.now()/utcnow() in proactivity src except the documented _SystemClock fallback in proactivity_sources.py, which app.py injects over. Reproducible under a fixed seed (e2e pins it).

[PASS] Architecture (DDD) + per-persona. domain/proactivity is pure (no I/O, no clock, frozen slots dataclasses); engine in application depends only on ports/protocols; composition is only in app.py. All state keyed by persona_id (store + engine + RecordOwnerActivity) so replicas are isolated. ProactiveTick is registered on the heartbeat cadence wrapped in _TICK_RETRY_POLICY (resilient). RecordOwnerActivity folds owner messages in best-effort (handle_message swallows + logs). All modules carry beadloom:domain=bob; lint --strict green.

[PASS] No regressions / no anti-human patterns. Reactive chat + authz/routing intact (owner_activity is an optional seam, unwired = prior behaviour; multibot /quiet,/wake fall through to a silent drop without a store). Gate + compose prompts lean on Higher Mind (mood tone, reflect salience) with no canned templates and no forced positivity.

== FINDING ==

[MINOR] Timed mute never auto-expires (known gap, non-blocking). guppi.py _quiet() on '/quiet 2h' both sets proactivity_enabled=False AND writes mute_until = now + 2h. But mute_until has NO consumer: engine.py:168 derives 'muted=not state.proactivity_enabled' and never reads store.get_mute_until(). So '/quiet 2h' behaves identically to a bare '/quiet' — permanent until '/wake'; the 2h auto-unmute never happens. The expiry check is MISSING from application/proactivity/engine.py:160-169 (_should_speak), which would need to read get_mute_until and treat 'now greater-or-equal expiry' as un-muted (ideally also clearing it). get_mute_until() exists (proactivity_store.py:101) and is round-trip tested, but nothing calls it in src (grep: zero consumers). Severity MINOR: functional gap, not a safety/correctness defect — the owner can always '/wake', the ceiling errs SAFE (stays quieter, never spams), and the persistence/command surface is already built so the consumer is a small follow-up. Recommend a follow-up bead (consume get_mute_until in _should_speak + a test asserting auto-unmute after expiry); does not block this merge.

- GUPPI reject path: route() returns False after _guppi_reject BEFORE the Bob intake call (multibot.py:260-264 vs 267) — Bob pipeline structurally unreachable on the reject path, not merely test-asserted. Verified test_unauthorized_in_bob_topic_triggers_guppi_reject (received==[], bob.sends==[]).

- Telegram stays in infrastructure behind ReplyStreamer/EventBus seam; Bob path publishes MessageReceived onto the bus (no direct coupling). lint --strict 0 violations (layering holds).
- BotRegistry is a clean seam: adding a bot == one register() call (forward-compatible for replicas). Composition only in app.py (_build_multibot). multibot.py + guppi.py both carry # beadloom:domain=bob (module coverage clean).

=== SECURITY (KEY): PASS ===
- No double-processing / no message loss: dedup key is unique per Telegram message; the gate is applied deterministically on first delivery, so suppressing the cross-bot duplicate cannot let an unauthorized message slip through the second bot, and cannot drop a distinct legit message. No auth bypass via the second bot.
- Authz no-bypass: the inner Bob TelegramGateway is constructed WITHOUT an authorizer (multibot.py:156-165), so the router's route() is the SINGLE gate for the Bob path — _inner[BOB].intake is only reached after _is_authorized passes (multibot.py:260-267). - Clock injection (SystemClock in app; _zero_clock for inner gateways). Parameterized SQL untouched (persistence unchanged). No print, no bare except (only typed excepts). No datetime.now() without Clock. No mutable defaults. Only # type: ignore additions are [attr-defined,no-any-return] at the untyped-aiogram boundary in _AiogramBotAdapter — justified, consistent with the existing adapter pattern.

- Minor (multibot.py:168) _seen_messages is an unbounded set growing for process lifetime (mirrors BOB-002 _seen_update_ids). Practical impact low (offset advancement stops Telegram redelivering old updates), but a long-lived process accumulates keys. Consider a bounded LRU/deque eviction in a follow-up. Pre-existing pattern, not introduced anew.
- Nitpick (multibot.py:213) poll-failure exc is logged verbatim; an aiogram network exception could in theory embed a token-bearing URL. Very low probability; consider scrubbing if ever observed.

comments.text:
REVIEW: VERDICT = OK (no blocking findings). BOB-002 batch on branch features/BOB-002. Validation: 413 tests pass, 98% coverage, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (46 files), beadloom lint --strict = 0 violations, beadloom doctor/reindex ok.

DIMENSION RESULTS (all PASS):

1) CORRECTNESS = PASS.
- aiogram migration preserves behavior: dedup via _seen_update_ids + offset advance (max(offset, update_id+1)) identical to BOB-001; draft streaming batches by batch_tokens, throttles via injected clock/sleep, backs off on TelegramRetryAfter (gateway.py:332-377).
- Rich path: MarkdownToRichMessage -> RichMessageSerializer -> send_rich_message; on any AiogramError/ValueError it degrades to plain send_message with length-split (gateway.py:381-403, 477-498). RichBlockThinking rendered as leading collapsible block when thinking present (rich.py:102-113). Empty reply with no thinking sends nothing.
- retry.py: is_transient classifies aiohttp ClientConnectionError (covers ServerDisconnectedError) + TimeoutError + 5xx as transient; everything else permanent and re-raised at once; CancelledError re-raised; bounded by max_attempts with exponential backoff (retry.py:50-111). Provider uses aiohttp so the classification matches the real client.
- Tick isolation: periodic() re-raises CancelledError, logs+continues on Exception, wraps tick in retry_with_backoff when a RetryPolicy is given (heartbeat.py:76-101). One bad tick cannot kill the loop or its siblings.
- Tool-loop TERMINATES: bounded by _DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=6, returns final text when no tool_calls, returns '' + warns on cap (tool_loop.py:61-73). Unknown capability fed back as tool error message; any dispatch Exception caught + logged so a tool failure never crashes the turn (tool_loop.py:75-91). Empty-registry path UNCHANGED: HandleMessage engages the loop only when a tool provider is wired AND registry is non-empty, else the plain router path (handle_message.py:191-203).

2) ARCHITECTURE (DDD/Clean) = PASS.
- New ports Capability, ToolCallingProvider, AllowlistStore (+ ToolCall/ToolCallResult value objects) all live in domain/ports.py. Gateway/persistence/llm stay in infrastructure; composition only in app.py.
- Gateway depends on application only via a structural AuthorizerLike Protocol + the MessageReceived event import (infra -> application is allowed); it never imports the concrete Authorizer (gateway.py:131-141).
- beadloom lint --strict = 0 violations; the layering guard test (tests/application/test_layering.py) holds and passed.

3) SECURITY (KEY) = PASS.
- Authz, single enforcement point: the ONLY gate is TelegramGateway.intake/_passes_gate (gateway.py:202-250). Dedup -> gate -> publish; no other path publishes MessageReceived. is_authorized is checked BEFORE owner-command handling, so an unauthorized update can never reach /authorize. Disallowed chat OR unauthorized user -> silently dropped (no MessageReceived, no reply).
- /authorize is owner-only: _handle_owner_command returns False unless is_owner(user_id); a non-owner's /authorize text simply falls through as an ordinary message (per RFC) (gateway.py:252-273).
- Chat-scope binds even the owner: Authorizer.is_authorized rejects any chat outside allowed_chat_ids for everyone (authorizer.py:53-65) -> a leaked token in a foreign chat is dead. Fail-closed defaults: owner_id=0 + empty allowed_chat_ids authorizes nobody.
- Token/ids from config/env only (app.py _build_real_bot/_build_authorizer; config/bob.example.yaml documents BOB_TELEGRAM__TOKEN etc.). Never inlined. Drop log records only user_id/chat_id, never the token/text (gateway.py:244-248).
- Tool-loop abuse: recall_memory is permission='safe', validates that 'query' is a str and raises otherwise (recall_memory.py:69-75). FTS injection sanitization HOLDS: _to_match_query tokenizes to word chars, drops operator punctuation, quotes each term, OR-joins; SQL is fully parameterized (fts_recall.py:59-111). A model-driven query cannot inject FTS operators or SQL.
- Privacy: capability results flow back as 'tool' messages within the same turn; HandleMessage keeps the BOB-001 Variant-2 split (shareable_context MAY reach Tier 1, private_context stays Tier-0-only and is empty in P0.1). No new private->Tier1 leak introduced (handle_message.py:173-216).

4) STANDARDS = PASS. Clock/sleep injected throughout (SystemClock, _async_sleep, _monotonic); parameterized SQL only; no print; no bare except (the two broad 'except Exception' in tool_loop/heartbeat are justified with comments, log via logger.exception, and re-raise CancelledError); secrets never logged; mypy --strict + ruff clean.

NON-BLOCKING NOTES (author discretion, not requiring a fix cycle):
- Nitpick (pre-existing, NOT a BOB-002 regression): _seen_update_ids grows unbounded over a 24/7 process. Confirmed identical on main (BOB-001). Since the poll offset advances past handled updates, dedup mainly guards in-batch redelivery; a bounded structure (e.g. deque maxlen) would be tidier. Out of scope for this batch.
- Info: beadloom sync-check reports architecture.md stale for the new/changed modules. This is EXPECTED and is exactly the work assigned to BEAD-10 (tech-writer, blocked on this review). Not a defect of the dev work; flagging so BEAD-10 covers all listed symbols (authz, capabilities/registry+tool_loop+recall_memory, runtime/retry, allowlist_store, telegram/rich+gateway, ports, app).

CONCLUSION: arrow OK. No Critical/Major/Minor findings. Special-attention items (authz bypass, tool-loop termination/abuse) both verified clean.

description: Read-only ревью; находки в комментарии беада. PLAN BEAD-09.

comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW (BEAD-09) — BOB-001 P0 slice (7 dev beads + test). Read-only. Verdict: ISSUES (1 Major, 2 Minor). Gates reproduced green locally: 216 pytest pass, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict 0 violations, sync-check rc0.

DIMENSION VERDICTS
- Correctness: PASS. perceive->decide->act->persist flow correct (handle_message.py). Tier1->Tier0 fallback correct and, crucially, the payload is built ONCE (llm_router.run -> _build_messages) so the redacted Tier-1 payload is exactly what the Tier-0 fallback sends — privacy holds on the fallback path too (explicitly tested: test_fallback_to_tier0_still_redacts_personal_context). Genesis idempotent via on-disk SOUL.md flag (run_genesis.run short-circuits, no LLM/file touch); malformed Tier1 output rejected loudly (GenesisError; 3 hardening tests). Mood/Taste/Negotiation pure + deterministic + bounded; heartbeat ticks (InnerMonologue feeds Mood, MoodDrift homeostasis, Reflect logs episode) correct and error-isolated in periodic().
- Security/Privacy: PASS. Redaction by construction: LLMRouter._build_messages attaches personal_context ONLY when the task's preferred tier is Tier 0 (stays_local); a Tier-1-bound request is never given the raw context. Asserted by unit + e2e privacy tests (recall-secret + phantom-secret never reach Tier 1). Secrets: telegram.token and llm.tier1_api_key come from config/env only (factory._optional_str, app._build_real_bot) — never inlined; no Authorization header when key absent (Tier 0). yaml.safe_load everywhere (loader, run_genesis). All SQL parameterized (?) — sqlite_repo.py is the single SQL home; FTS user text tokenized to OR-of-quoted-terms (fts_recall._to_match_query) — injection/syntax safe. pathlib throughout.
- Standards (CONTEXT.md): PASS. datetime.now() appears ONLY inside SystemClock.now() in app.py; everywhere else the injected Clock is used. No print(), no bare except, no mutable defaults. Domain dataclasses frozen+slots with invariant checks in __post_init__. Type hints on public surfaces.

FINDINGS

Major 1 — Architecture: application layer imports concrete infrastructure types (violates infra->application->domain).
- src/bob/application/usecases/handle_message.py:45 — 'from bob.infrastructure.telegram.events import MessageReceived'
- src/bob/application/usecases/run_genesis.py:44 — 'from bob.infrastructure.persistence.soul_store import JsonValue, SoulStore'
Why: declared layering is infrastructure -> application -> domain; the application must not depend on infrastructure. Both imports are TYPE_CHECKING-only (no runtime cycle, wiring still in app.py), but they are a real layering leak AND directly contradict this layer's own stated invariant — application/__init__.py docstring says it 'never imports bob.infrastructure'. So either the code or the documented invariant is wrong.
Recommendation: move the transport event + persistence contract the use-cases depend on to a layer the application owns. (a) Define MessageReceived (or a MessageReceivedLike Protocol carrying chat_id/text/sender_name) in domain/ports or application; the telegram gateway produces it, the use-case consumes the abstraction. (b) RunGenesis should depend on a SoulStore *port* (Protocol) declared in domain/application, with the concrete Sqlite/file SoulStore bound in app.py; JsonValue likewise belongs with that port, not imported from persistence. Net: zero application->infrastructure imports, restoring the docstring's invariant.

Minor 1 — Architecture/graph: beadloom lint --strict evaluated only 1 rule and the entire src/bob tree is annotated as a single 'beadloom:domain=bob' node, so the graph has no layer sub-model and CANNOT enforce the infra/app/domain boundary (it did not catch Major 1). The hexagon is real in the source but invisible to the tool. Recommendation (for the tech-writer/graph bead BEAD-10): introduce per-layer beadloom nodes (domain / application / infrastructure) + a forbid-import rule application->infrastructure so the boundary is machine-checked, not just convention.

Minor 2 — Typing consistency: src/bob/app.py _PtbBotAdapter.get_updates (l.406) and send_message (l.409) carry '# type: ignore[no-untyped-def]' and omit return annotations, while edit_message_text (l.412) is annotated '-> object'. The ignores at the PTB boundary are justified, but annotate the two return types (-> Sequence[UpdateLike] / -> _MessageLike or object) to drop the no-untyped-def ignores and match the third method.

Nitpick — tests/application/usecases/test_run_genesis_hardening.py imports the private _parse_personality. Acceptable (it tests the validation contract) but a public seam would be cleaner.

RESULT: ISSUES — 0 critical, 1 major, 2 minor. Do NOT merge until Major 1 (application->infrastructure layering leak) is fixed; coordinator to open a fix-bead. Minor 1 fits naturally into the BEAD-10 graph/docs work.

comments.text:
CHECKPOINT (.2 R4): recall-aware anti-repeat on the proactive path.

WHAT: ProactivityEngine now guards the composed proactive message against Bob's OWN recalled past replies before posting (was unguarded — could copy a recalled reply verbatim, a self-initiated repeat).

CHOICE — regenerate-then-SKIP: on a caught repeat, regenerate up to _MAX_REGENERATIONS (=2), dropping the matched recalled exemplar each retry (attractor-breaking, mirrors .1). If it STILL repeats after the bound -> return None -> SKIP posting this tick (no post, no state advance, no episode persisted). Rationale: unlike the reactive turn, a self-initiated proactive message has no user awaiting an answer, so suppressing a stuck repeat is safer than sending it. Non-repeating drafts post on the first compose (no needless regeneration); grounding (FACT memories) is preserved — only the copied REPLY exemplar is withheld from retries.

== 1. Privacy invariant (highest priority) — AIRTIGHT ==
- PrivacyGuard is a pure frozen domain object (no I/O, no LLM), single source of truth; allowlist roots src/tests/docs, everything else DENIED (data/soul/**, data/bob.db*, .env*, config/**, repo-root files, ..-escape, absolute-outside-repo). Pure _resolve collapses ../. without disk access → cannot be prompt-bypassed.
- The .3 symlink fix (_real_path_is_allowed) is CORRECT and COMPLETE. Order of enforcement in read_file: (a) pure name-based guard.allows_path BEFORE any disk touch; (b) realpath-containment re-check that resolves symlinks and re-asserts the REAL path stays under an allowed root BEFORE open. Containment is computed on realpaths for BOTH target and roots (os.path.realpath), so a symlinked repo root (macOS /var→/private/var) is not a false denial, while a link escaping into a denied tree is refused with no read.
- Bypass surface checked: symlink→denied-root, symlink→.env, symlink→outside-repo, symlink-within-root (no false denial), absolute path, ../ traversal into config, lookalike roots (srcfoo/src_extra), parent denied roots — all covered by tests (test_privacy_guard.py, test_subprocess_introspector.py US-6 block). guard consulted BEFORE disk access everywhere.
- inspect_architecture/list_work surface beadloom/bd graph+tracker metadata (not Bob's 'innards'); ALL CLI output passes guard.sanitize() (env-assignment + api-key/token redaction). read_file output also line-capped + sanitized. No personal file-content path leaks.

Minor (defense-in-depth, author's discretion): subprocess_introspector.read_file lines 137-143 — there is a TOCTOU window between _real_path_is_allowed() and target.read_text(). Exploiting it requires local filesystem write access to swap a symlink mid-call, which is outside the Phase-A threat model (read-only, owner-only, local; the prompt cannot manipulate the FS). Acceptable for Phase A; could note it as a known limitation in the .5 architecture doc. Not a blocker.

== 2. Read-only & stage boundary — PASS ==
- No write/execute path. _ExecRunner uses asyncio.create_subprocess_exec (NOT shell). FIXED read-only subcommand allowlist (beadloom: ctx/graph/why/search; bd: ready/show); unknown binary, off-allowlist subcommand, and any flag-looking arg (startswith '-') are refused with DisallowedCommandError WITHOUT execution (tests assert runner.calls == []). Timeout (default 30s) + output truncation (default 20k chars) present; killed proc is drained (no zombie).
- The three skills are NOT on goals.safe_capabilities (default []). Enforced, not just configured: test_safe_dispatcher_default_allowlist_refuses_introspection_caps builds a SafeCapabilityDispatcher over the LIVE registry and asserts allows()==False + CapabilityNotAllowedError on dispatch. Conversation-only confirmed.

== 3. DDD/Clean & determinism — PASS ==
- Domain (PrivacyGuard) pure, no I/O; infra does I/O; capabilities are thin policy (validate→delegate→render, honest US-5 not-found). Ports = Protocol, injected; runner injected as a callable for deterministic fakes. No Any/# type: ignore, no print/bare-except/import */mutable-default/shell. dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True). pathlib used. beadloom annotations present; lint green.

== 4. Backward-compat / no regressions — PASS ==
- introspection.enabled=false → registry holds exactly recall_memory + search_memory; tests assert disjoint introspection caps AND memory caps untouched in BOTH modes. Production default is genuinely True via ConfigLoader deep-merge of DEFAULT_CONFIG (test_introspection_config.py); the in-memory _flag fallback to False on a missing key is consistent with other switches and only affects raw-dict configs, not production load.

== 5. Tests — ADEQUATE ==
- Privacy bypass cases thoroughly covered (pure guard + infra realpath + capability-layer DeniedPathError propagation 'never fabricated'). AAA, behavior-focused, tmp paths only, deterministic fakes (no real subprocess except two _ExecRunner smoke tests with printf/sleep). Coverage ≥80% comfortably.

Nitpicks (ignorable): (a) read_file's _looks_like_path routing treats extension-less paths (src/bob/domain) as search — intentional and documented/tested; fine. (b) _BEADLOOM_SUBCOMMANDS includes 'why'/'graph' though the port only ever calls ctx/search/show/ready — harmless extra allowlist headroom, not a leak.

Conclusion: read-only hard, privacy invariant not bypassable (incl. the .3 symlink fix), stage boundary enforced, DDD clean, no regressions, tests solid. APPROVED.

ОБИДА/ОХЛАЖДЕНИЕ вместо книжного Exodus hard-reset: критическое устойчивое падение -> Боб входит в состояние обиды (проактив подавлен, реактив холодный); GUPPI сообщает пользователю, что Боб обижен и не хочет говорить; внутренняя рефлексия ПОСТЕПЕННО восстанавливает желание (затухание обиды + отогрев от тепла) -> возвращается. Как люди: обиделся->молчишь->отходишь->общаешься. Память ЦЕЛА (без reset). Guardrails: не по мелочи; гарантированно отходит (нет вечной блокировки). Зависит от BOB-013 (done).
close_reason: RelationshipTracker (per-person) + аппетит к разговору + обида/Sulk (гарант. выход, anti-Exodus) + guest-disengage + восприятие мата; 1231 тест, review OK (0 находок, guardrails airtight), Gate зелёный. ЗАКРЫВАЕТ Тир 1.

title: [BOB-013] Само-эволюция: рефлексия меняет вкусы/убеждения/baseline (с guardrails)
description: ПРОБЛЕМА: после boot SOUL меняется ТОЛЬКО через with_mood; taste/baseline/identity/phantom заморожены (run_genesis пишет душу однократно; ReflectTick.run heartbeat.py:142-163 делает только save_episode; experience_count не инкрементится). RFC §3.3 TasteEvolution.apply_reflection не реализован. ФИКС: новый domain/personality/taste_evolution.py (reinforce, чистый, RFC 1480-1538) + soul.py (+with_taste/with_baseline) + новый use-case ApplyReflection после REFLECT (парс → MoodDelta + reinforce → with_mood/with_taste → write_json персист; round-trip готов через _load_soul). GUARDRAILS: conviction в [0,1], value сдвигается МЕДЛЕННЕЕ при высокой conviction (анти-runaway), идемпотентность на повтор тика, experience_count++. Тесты на фейках (фейк-роутер+фейк-SoulStore). Детали — AUDIT.md.

title: [BOB-013] Negotiation-врезка: Боб отстаивает свои ценности (3-зонный движок → ответ)
description: ПРОБЛЕМА: Negotiation.decide (negotiation.py:56-74) имеет НОЛЬ потребителей вне ре-экспорта/тестов; не импортится в app.py. 'Не yes-man' работает случайно. ШОВ: handle_message._decide (224-260) + _assemble_shareable_context (297-325) кладут taste-вердикт, но не стойку; системный промпт (79-82) безусловно 'warmly'. ФИКС: классифицировать зону (BOB_PERSONAL/SHARED/USER_DOMAIN) → conviction оси из taste → decide() → map Stance в директиву промпта. Порт: переиспользовать LLMRouter (новый TaskType зоны, Tier 0) либо эвристика. Тесты на фейках: HATE+high conviction в BOB_PERSONAL → отстаивает; USER_DOMAIN → CONCEDE. Детали — AUDIT.md.

title: [BOB-033] Эмоциональная саморегуляция Боба (человеческая внутренняя жизнь)
description: Боб сползал в апатию/меланхолию при любом генезисе: Tier-0 Qwen дефолтит рефлексии в меланхолию + нет человеческой саморегуляции + текст рефлексий копировался в ответы. Строим человеческую регуляцию (диспозиция-аттрактор + живые рефлексии + вероятностный реаппрайзал + симметричная соц-зарядка асимметрией в плюс + контейнмент мимикрии), из которой канон-оптимизм возникает сам. Не скрипт, не механистично. См. PRD/RFC/CONTEXT/PLAN в .claude/development/docs/features/BOB-033/.
